subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about closing the gap between a registered user and a funded one for {Brand}. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the funded account, the one that clears KYC and lands a first deposit, and read it back through a server-to-server postback before it counts, so you pay for validated funded accounts at an eCPA of $58 with bonus-farming and multi-accounting screened out first. If it helps, I can pull the funded-account and KYC-pass read by source on Android-first Nigerian supply. Worth a short look?
illustrative_flags: eCPA on the funded account of $58 (MobUpps-specific cost-per-funded-account, illustrative placeholder; never an established MobUpps result)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN Nigeria neobank native English (no transliteration; English is the business register of Nigerian fintech): references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof = MAFO optimized to funded account + S2S funding postback + KYC-pass + bonus/multi-accounting screening; one illustrative MobUpps figure (eCPA $58 on funded account); soft CTA; exactly one question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' comma-negation.
